title: Branded rider shell / masked Apps Script origin

frontend: Move rider-facing request/status surfaces behind a Pulse-branded HTTPS frontend
Use Pulse/VT URL instead of exposing script.google.com to riders
Reuse confirmation-email hero treatment as rider-app shell
Provide status progress and later route/map panel inside the branded shell
backend: Keep Apps Script as the protected request/status backend initially
Use a controlled proxy/API boundary rather than trying to hide Google-owned browser chrome inside Apps Script HTML
Preserve existing Ride ID/PIN or replace with an equally private signed access token only after migration testing

acceptance: Rider sees a Pulse-branded URL and no Apps Script banner/chrome
Existing QR and future-booking links can migrate without changing ride data
No private backend URL or credentials exposed in page content
Rollback to direct Apps Script URL remains possible during beta
